# Monoline

> Open-source UI kit: a plain CSS core (@monoline/css) with accessible React components (@monoline/react). Three themes, four accents, no Tailwind, no runtime CSS-in-JS.

Start with AGENTS.md (how to work in this repo) and DESIGN.md (the look and rules). Every component is a folder with source, test, demo and meta.json.

## Accordion (accordion)
Stacked headings that each show or hide a section.
Import: import {Accordion} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: radix-ui/Accordion | Status: stable
A11y:
- Each trigger is a button inside a heading with aria-expanded and aria-controls.
- Enter and Space toggle; Arrow keys, Home and End move between triggers.
- single or multiple open items; collapsible lets the last one close.
Files: packages/react/src/components/accordion/accordion.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/accordion/accordion.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/accordion/accordion.tsx, packages/react/src/components/accordion/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/accordion/meta.json

## Alert (alert)
A message that stays on screen, with a title and a tone.
Import: import {Alert} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: none | Status: stable
A11y:
- danger and warning are role=alert and announced at once; info and success are role=status and polite.
- The title always states the meaning in words; colour is not the only signal.
Files: packages/react/src/components/alert/alert.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/alert/alert.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/alert/alert.tsx, packages/react/src/components/alert/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/alert/meta.json

## Avatar (avatar)
A person or thing as an image with an initials fallback.
Import: import {Avatar} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: radix-ui/Avatar | Status: stable
A11y:
- name is required: it is the image alt text and the fallback's accessible name.
- The fallback shows while the image loads or if it fails.
Files: packages/react/src/components/avatar/avatar.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/avatar/avatar.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/avatar/avatar.tsx, packages/react/src/components/avatar/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/avatar/meta.json

## Badge (badge)
A short status word or count.
Import: import {Badge} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: none | Status: stable
A11y:
- Plain text in a span; the word carries the meaning, not the colour.
- For a count that changes, put it inside an aria-live region yourself.
Files: packages/react/src/components/badge/badge.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/badge/badge.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/badge/badge.tsx, packages/react/src/components/badge/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/badge/meta.json

## Button (button)
Triggers an action. Native button with solid, line, ghost and danger variants.
Import: import {Button} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: radix-ui/Slot | Status: stable
A11y:
- Native <button>: Enter and Space activate, Tab focuses.
- loading sets aria-busy and blocks clicks while keeping the label.
- asChild renders a link without losing link semantics.
Files: packages/react/src/components/button/button.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/button/button.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/button/button.tsx, packages/react/src/components/button/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/button/meta.json

## Card (card)
A bordered group for one thing you can pick up or open.
Import: import {Card} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: radix-ui/Slot | Status: stable
A11y:
- Plain divs and a heading; no roles added.
- With asChild on a link or button the whole card is one keyboard-focusable control.
Files: packages/react/src/components/card/card.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/card/card.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/card/card.tsx, packages/react/src/components/card/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/card/meta.json

## Checkbox (checkbox)
A box to turn one choice on or off, with an indeterminate state.
Import: import {Checkbox} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: radix-ui/Checkbox | Status: stable
A11y:
- role=checkbox; Space toggles; Tab focuses.
- indeterminate is exposed as aria-checked=mixed.
- A visible label is clickable; without one, aria-label is required.
Files: packages/react/src/components/checkbox/checkbox.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/checkbox/checkbox.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/checkbox/checkbox.tsx, packages/react/src/components/checkbox/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/checkbox/meta.json

## Dialog (dialog)
A modal window for a question or short task that blocks the page.
Import: import {Dialog} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: radix-ui/Dialog | Status: stable
A11y:
- role=dialog with aria-modal; the title names it and the description describes it.
- Focus moves into the dialog, is trapped there, and returns to the trigger on close.
- Escape and the Close button close it; the page behind is inert.
Files: packages/react/src/components/dialog/dialog.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/dialog/dialog.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/dialog/dialog.tsx, packages/react/src/components/dialog/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/dialog/meta.json

## Field (field)
Connects a label, a control, a hint and an error with the right ids and ARIA.
Import: import {Field} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: none | Status: stable
A11y:
- The label is bound to the control by id, so it has an accessible name.
- Hint and error are linked with aria-describedby; an error sets aria-invalid and is announced via role=alert.
- required sets the native required attribute on the control.
Files: packages/react/src/components/field/field.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/field/field.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/field/field.tsx, packages/react/src/components/field/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/field/meta.json

## Input (input)
A single-line text field.
Import: import {Input} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: none | Status: stable
A11y:
- Native <input>: all keyboard and autofill behaviour is the browser's.
- Inside a Field it is labelled and described automatically; invalid sets aria-invalid.
Files: packages/react/src/components/input/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/input/input.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/input/input.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/input/input.tsx, packages/react/src/components/input/meta.json

## Label (label)
The visible name of a form control.
Import: import {Label} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: radix-ui/Label | Status: stable
A11y:
- A real <label>: clicking it focuses the control it names.
- required adds a visual marker; set required on the control for assistive tech.
Files: packages/react/src/components/label/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/label/label.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/label/label.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/label/label.tsx, packages/react/src/components/label/meta.json

## Progress (progress)
How far along a task is, or that it is still working.
Import: import {Progress} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: radix-ui/Progress | Status: stable
A11y:
- role=progressbar with aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin and aria-valuemax.
- Indeterminate omits aria-valuenow.
- aria-label is required.
Files: packages/react/src/components/progress/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/progress/meta.json, packages/react/src/components/progress/progress.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/progress/progress.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/progress/progress.tsx

## Radio group (radio-group)
Pick exactly one option from a short list.
Import: import {RadioGroup} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: radix-ui/RadioGroup | Status: stable
A11y:
- role=radiogroup with role=radio items; one Tab stop for the group.
- Arrow keys move and select; Space selects the focused item.
- Give the group an accessible name with aria-label or aria-labelledby.
Files: packages/react/src/components/radio-group/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/radio-group/meta.json, packages/react/src/components/radio-group/radio-group.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/radio-group/radio-group.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/radio-group/radio-group.tsx

## Separator (separator)
A thin rule between groups.
Import: import {Separator} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: radix-ui/Separator | Status: stable
A11y:
- Decorative by default: role=none so screen readers skip it.
- With decorative=false it is role=separator with aria-orientation.
Files: packages/react/src/components/separator/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/separator/meta.json, packages/react/src/components/separator/separator.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/separator/separator.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/separator/separator.tsx

## Skeleton (skeleton)
A still placeholder shaped like the content that is loading.
Import: import {Skeleton} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: none | Status: stable
A11y:
- aria-hidden: it carries no information.
- Pair with an aria-busy region or a Spinner so loading is announced once.
Files: packages/react/src/components/skeleton/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/skeleton/meta.json, packages/react/src/components/skeleton/skeleton.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/skeleton/skeleton.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/skeleton/skeleton.tsx

## Spinner (spinner)
A small indicator that something is loading.
Import: import {Spinner} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: none | Status: stable
A11y:
- role=status with an aria-label; polite, not interrupting.
- Animation stops under prefers-reduced-motion.
Files: packages/react/src/components/spinner/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/spinner/meta.json, packages/react/src/components/spinner/spinner.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/spinner/spinner.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/spinner/spinner.tsx

## Switch (switch)
An on/off setting that takes effect immediately.
Import: import {Switch} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: radix-ui/Switch | Status: stable
A11y:
- role=switch with aria-checked; Space and Enter toggle.
- A visible label is clickable; without one, aria-label is required.
Files: packages/react/src/components/switch/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/switch/meta.json, packages/react/src/components/switch/switch.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/switch/switch.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/switch/switch.tsx

## Tabs (tabs)
Switch between related views in the same place.
Import: import {Tabs} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: radix-ui/Tabs | Status: stable
A11y:
- role=tablist, tab and tabpanel with aria-selected and aria-controls.
- Arrow keys move between tabs, Home and End jump; only the active tab is a Tab stop.
- Give the list an accessible name with aria-label.
Files: packages/react/src/components/tabs/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/tabs/meta.json, packages/react/src/components/tabs/tabs.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/tabs/tabs.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/tabs/tabs.tsx

## Textarea (textarea)
A multi-line text field.
Import: import {Textarea} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: none | Status: stable
A11y:
- Native <textarea>.
- Inside a Field it is labelled and described automatically; invalid sets aria-invalid.
Files: packages/react/src/components/textarea/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/textarea/meta.json, packages/react/src/components/textarea/textarea.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/textarea/textarea.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/textarea/textarea.tsx

## Tooltip (tooltip)
Short hint text on hover and keyboard focus.
Import: import {Tooltip} from '@monoline/react'
Primitive: radix-ui/Tooltip | Status: stable
A11y:
- Shows on hover and on keyboard focus; the trigger gets aria-describedby while it is open.
- Escape dismisses it; it stays open while the pointer is over it.
- Never the only place for essential information: touch users do not get hover.
Files: packages/react/src/components/tooltip/index.ts, packages/react/src/components/tooltip/meta.json, packages/react/src/components/tooltip/tooltip.demo.tsx, packages/react/src/components/tooltip/tooltip.test.tsx, packages/react/src/components/tooltip/tooltip.tsx
